Batch.description:
A batch (``reactor: batch``; the model: :mod:`.stirred_tank`): the inlet is the charge
(its flow the charge per hour), the outlet its composition when the batch ends, after
``time`` or at the ``target`` conversion; isothermal or adiabatic. A liquid batch keeps its
composition's volume (ideal mixing), a gas batch its volume (the pressure changes).

A semi-batch (``reactor: semibatch``, liquid) adds the ``dosing`` feeds to the charge; its
``time`` or ``target`` is the post-reaction after the last dose (neither: it ends with the
dosing). A liquid batch or semi-batch with a ``vent`` gives off the vent's components as
they form, by a second outlet.

catalyst_loading.description: kg of catalyst per m3: rate laws per kg of catalyst.
catalyst_loading.title: Catalyst Loading

vent.description: A liquid batch or semi-batch that gives off gas: {stream, components, fraction} (ADR 0054).

Batch.title: Batch

key.description: The component whose conversion ends the batch.
key.title: Key

diameter.description: m, of a tube (or the vessel): pressure drop, cooling

viscosity.title: Viscosity

time_on_stream.title: Time On Stream

energy_port.description: A batch or semi-batch reactor, batch still, crystallizer or conversion step: the energy port whose stream carries the model's year-average duty (cheme process propagate writes it, or compares a given one); default: its one heat stream (an energy stream from or to a heating or cooling utility). A stream from or to another block or step is heat only where energy_port names it.

still.description: A batch (Rayleigh) still or solvent swap.

crystallizer.description: A crystallizer (with its filter and recycle).

solid_separation.description: A filter or centrifuge on its own.

reactions.description: Reaction ids of process/reactions.yaml that take place here: the balance is reactive (elements and extents instead of components).
reactions.title: Reactions

conversion.description: Reaction id -> conversion of its key component here, instead of the reaction's own conversion (cheme process propagate).
conversion.title: Conversion

reactor.description: How cheme process propagate solves the outlet: conversion (of each reaction's key component), equilibrium (of the reactions, ideal gas, at the outlet's temperature and pressure), gibbs (every reaction among the stream's components) or pfr (a fixed bed: the reactions' rate laws along its bed), cstr (stirred tanks: the rate laws at the outlet), batch (the rate laws over the batch time) or semibatch (a batch with feeds dosed into its charge: batch.dosing); none: conversion when every reaction has one.
reactor.title: Reactor

hazard.description: TD24 and MTT for the thermal screening of the reactor.

selectivity.description: A conversion reactor by the key's conversion and the selectivities to its products (instead of a conversion per reaction).

batch.description: reactor: batch or semibatch: the batch.

catalyst.description: The catalyst its bed holds: an id of process/catalysts.yaml.
catalyst.title: Catalyst

fugacity.description: Equilibrium and Gibbs reactors: the gas as ideal, or with Peng-Robinson fugacity coefficients (the components' critical constants) for high pressures.
fugacity.title: Fugacity

approach.description: Equilibrium and Gibbs reactors: K is taken at the outlet temperature plus this approach, K (positive: less conversion of an exothermic reaction).
approach.title: Approach

method.description: The class's method where DEXPI has one (e.g. Compressing).
method.title: Method

parent.description: The block this block is drawn inside on the PFD (the BFD shows top-level blocks); its ports delegate the parent's ports where streams cross the parent boundary.
parent.title: Parent

split.description: A splitter block without steps: outlet port -> fraction of the inlet flow.
split.title: Split

Boilup.description:
A batch still's boil-up, constant: a vapour rate of one still (kmol/h, kmol/s, kg/h),
its heat input (kW, with the components' heat_of_vaporization) or a specific rate (1/h: kmol
of vapour per hour per kmol of the charge).
Boilup.title: Boilup

CakeLiquid.description: The liquid (mother liquor) held in a filter or centrifuge cake.

basis.description: mass_fraction: liquid over the wet cake's mass (below 1); per_kg_solid: kg of liquid per kg of dry solid.
basis.title: Basis

CakeLiquid.title: CakeLiquid

capacity.description: The declared capacity of this case, e.g. 500 t/d GOX.
capacity.title: Capacity

provenance.description: How the case's operating point is known (given, calculated, assumed, extrapolated).
provenance.title: Provenance

source.description: What the case's operating point rests on.
source.title: Source

CaseApplicability.description: Where a case's flows and duties hold: an envelope with its source, not a scaling law.
CaseApplicability.title: CaseApplicability

Column.description:
A batch still's rectifying column on the Fenske-Underwood-Gilliland shortcut (Diwekar's
batch shortcut: :mod:`.batch_still`): ``stages`` theoretical stages, the still included (or
``minimum_reflux_factor``: the stages from Gilliland at the start, at that factor times
Underwood's minimum reflux for ``distillate``), total condenser, no holdup. ``reflux:
constant`` at ``ratio`` (L/D; with the factor: the factor times the minimum at the start),
or ``constant_distillate``: the reflux ratio rises to hold the ``distillate``'s mole
fraction of its key, up to ``maximum_ratio``, and stays there after.

minimum_reflux_factor.description: Instead of stages: R = factor x Rmin at the start for the distillate, the stages from Gilliland there.
minimum_reflux_factor.title: Minimum Reflux Factor

ratio.description: reflux constant with stages: the reflux ratio L/D.
ratio.title: Ratio

distillate.description: constant_distillate: the distillate held; with minimum_reflux_factor: the distillate at the start the column is designed for.

maximum_ratio.description: constant_distillate: the largest reflux ratio; past it the reflux stays there and the distillate's purity falls.
maximum_ratio.title: Maximum Ratio

heavy_key.description: The heavy key of Underwood's minimum reflux; default: the next less volatile component of the charge after the distillate's key (else after the most volatile).
heavy_key.title: Heavy Key

Column.title: Column

key.description: The light key, the component the distillate is held in.
key.title: Key

fingerprint.description: Calculated compositions: the inputs they were derived from (cheme process propagate); a mismatch is cheme.process-calculated-stale.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

uncertainty.description: Of every fraction, relative to it (as on a quantity).

origin.description: What kind of figure it is (as on a quantity).
origin.title: Origin

Convergence.description: How ``cheme process propagate`` converges the loops torn at ``tears`` (ADR 0060).

method.description: Successive substitution, accelerated by Wegstein's method per component (q bounded to [-5, 0]) or not.
method.title: Method

damping.description: Substitution only: the share of the step to the new iterate taken.
damping.title: Damping

tolerance.description: Per component of every tear stream, kg/h; default: the flowsheet's.

Convergence.title: Convergence

Crystallizer.description:
A cooling or evaporative crystallizer for one solute in one solvent (the model:
:mod:`.crystallization`; no population balance, no kinetics): the crystals are the solid
component ``crystal`` (``phase: solid``; a hydrate's formula is the solute's plus n
solvent). ``basis: solubility`` predicts the yield from the solubility at ``temperature``
(the mother liquor leaves saturated); ``basis: yield`` imposes it. With ``separation`` a
filter or centrifuge follows (outlets ``cake`` and ``mother_liquor``), else one ``slurry``
outlet; ``recycle`` returns part of the filtrate to the feed. ``spectators`` are other
dissolved components carried unchanged (a precipitation from a reaction liquor); its
inlets are taken together (a reslurry wash: the cake and the wash liquid).

spectators.description: Dissolved components besides the solute and solvent (salts, base, unreacted reagent): carried unchanged in the mother liquor, never crystallized or evaporated; the solubility then needs measured_in: mother_liquor or salting_out:.
spectators.title: Spectators

Crystallizer.title: Crystallizer

CrystallizerEnergy.description:
Data of the crystallizer's lumped energy balance, from the feed's temperature to the
crystallizer's (every outlet leaves at it).

heat_capacity.description: kJ/(kg K) of the feed solution, constant
heat_capacity.title: Heat Capacity

heat_of_crystallization.description: kJ per kg of crystal formed, at the crystallizer's temperature: the enthalpy change, negative when crystallization releases heat.
heat_of_crystallization.title: Heat Of Crystallization

latent_heat.description: kJ per kg of solvent evaporated (with evaporation)
latent_heat.title: Latent Heat

feed_temperature.description: K; default: the inlet stream's temperature
feed_temperature.title: Feed Temperature

CrystallizerEnergy.title: CrystallizerEnergy

Declared.description: One positive figure with its provenance.
Declared.title: Declared

Dosing.description:
A feed dosed into a semi-batch (``reactor: semibatch``): an inlet stream of the step,
its flow the amount dosed per hour of charge, fed from ``start`` at a constant rate over
``time``, or in the ``profile``'s segments one after the other.

stream.description: The inlet stream dosed (the step's other inlets: the charge).
stream.title: Stream

time.description: s of dosing at a constant rate
time.title: Time

profile.description: (s, share of the feed) segments, each at a constant rate, one after the other; the shares add up to 1.
profile.title: Profile

start.description: s after the charge the dosing starts
start.title: Start

absorbed.description: A dosed gas: the share of the dose the liquid takes up (it dissolves on entry); the rest passes through to batch.vent's stream. None: all of it dissolves.
absorbed.title: Absorbed

Dosing.title: Dosing

Dryer.description:
A batch (filter-)dryer or vacuum dryer (:mod:`.dryer`): one wet-cake inlet, the dried
product and the vapour out. The ``volatiles`` leave as vapour down to the
``residual_moisture``; every other component (the solid, and what the cake liquid held
dissolved) stays in the product. The energy (``energy:``) is the cake's sensible heat to
the drying ``temperature``, the latent heat of the volatiles evaporated and the vessel's
heat per batch. The drying time (a recipe's ``dry`` ``from:`` this step) is the vapour of a
batch over the ``drying_rate`` times the heated area of the recipe's vessel, or the given
``drying_time``.

drying_rate.description: kg evaporated per m2 of heated area and hour, constant

cake_density.description: kg/m3 of the wet cake (bulk): sizes the recipe's vessel and its heated area

Dryer.title: Dryer

DryerEnergy.description:
The dryer's heat: the wet cake from its inlet temperature to the drying temperature,
the volatiles evaporated at it, and (per batch) the vessel, over an efficiency.

heat_capacity.description: kJ/(kg K) of the wet cake, constant
heat_capacity.title: Heat Capacity

latent_heat.description: kJ per kg evaporated, per volatile at the drying temperature; default: from the component's critical constants (Pitzer's corresponding states).
latent_heat.title: Latent Heat

inlet_temperature.description: K of the wet cake; default: the inlet stream's
inlet_temperature.title: Inlet Temperature

vessel_heat_capacity.description: kJ/K of the vessel heated with each batch (its metal mass x cp); counted per batch of process/recipe.yaml.
vessel_heat_capacity.title: Vessel Heat Capacity

efficiency.description: Heat to the cake over the heat supplied
efficiency.title: Efficiency

port.description: The energy inlet port of the heat: its duty is compared.
port.title: Port

DryerEnergy.title: DryerEnergy

Evaporation.description:
Solvent removed as vapour before or in the crystallizer, one of: ``flow`` (kg/h),
``feed_fraction`` (of the crystallizer feed's total mass), ``solvent_fraction`` (of the
feed's solvent) or ``concentration`` (the solute's mass fraction in the liquid after
evaporation, crystals not yet formed).
Evaporation.title: Evaporation

Filtration.description:
A constant-pressure cake filtration (Ruth): the time to pass one batch's filtrate,
``t = mu (alpha M V / (2 A^2) + R_m V / A) / dP`` with M the dry solid of the cake and V
the filtrate's volume per batch (:mod:`.dryer`; ``filter`` ``from:`` this step in
``process/recipe.yaml``). The split itself stays the specified one.

area.description: m2; default: the recipe vessel's bottom (a Nutsche)
area.title: Area

Filtration.title: Filtration

ImposedYield.description:
The fraction of the anhydrous solute entering the crystallizer that crystallizes,
specified (an empirical or vendor yield), not predicted.
ImposedYield.title: ImposedYield

Link.description: What a process object is in the plant: equipment, a line, an instrument or a sheet.
Link.title: Link

MotherLiquorRecycle.description:
The fraction of the filtrate returned to the crystallizer's feed (before evaporation);
the rest leaves as the purge.
MotherLiquorRecycle.title: MotherLiquorRecycle

delegates.description: Steps and nested blocks: the port of the step's block (the nested block's parent) this port stands for, when a stream crosses that boundary here.
delegates.title: Delegates

key.description: The component whose share in the cut collected ends it.
key.title: Key

fraction.description: The cut's mean share of the key (on the end's basis).
fraction.title: Fraction

fingerprint.description: Calculated values: the inputs (T, P, composition, method) they were calculated from; a mismatch is cheme.process-calculated-stale.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

uncertainty.description: Relative to the value, e.g. {gsd2: 1.2} or {distribution: triangular, low: 0.9, high: 1.1}; cheme assess lca samples a feed's or product's flow with it instead of the default for its provenance. No calculated value's fingerprint includes it.

origin.description: What kind of figure it is, refining the provenance: given measured, vendor or literature; assumed design-rule, estimate or literature; calculated simulated (cheme process simulate) or correlation (cheme process props). Another pairing is cheme.provenance-origin. No calculated value's fingerprint includes it.
origin.title: Origin

ReactionHazard.description:
What the thermal screening of a reactor (``cheme process reactor-hazards``) needs beyond
the reactions: the decomposition and the technical limit, from calorimetry and the design.

td24.description: K: the temperature at which the decomposition's adiabatic time to maximum rate is 24 h (DSC, ARC; never estimated here).
td24.title: Td24

mtt.description: K: the maximum technical temperature (the boiling point at the reactor's pressure, a relief set temperature); default: the lowest boiling point of the liquid's components at the reactor's pressure (the normal boiling point at about atmospheric pressure, else Clausius-Clapeyron with heat_of_vaporization), leaving out a batch's vent components, a dosed gas and dissolved gases (a minor share of the liquid boiling below the process temperature; ADR 0058).
mtt.title: Mtt

reactions.description: The reactions of the step whose heat sets dT_ad and the MTSR (each run to completion, the largest counts), e.g. the main reaction without a slow side reaction (ADR 0058). Default: every reaction.
reactions.title: Reactions

vent_capacity.description: m3/h of gas the vent and its line pass at the vessel's pressure, from the vent sizing: compared with the gas a vented batch gives off at the MTSR (ADR 0058).
vent_capacity.title: Vent Capacity

ReactionHazard.title: ReactionHazard

ResidualMoisture.description: The volatiles a dried product keeps: the dryer's specification.

basis.description: mass_fraction: volatiles over the dried product's mass (below 1); per_kg_solid: kg of volatiles per kg of dry solid (everything not volatile).
basis.title: Basis

ResidualMoisture.title: ResidualMoisture

key.description: The component whose mole fraction in the still ends it.
key.title: Key

SaltingOut.description:
The Setschenow correction of a pure-solvent solubility for the spectator solutes of the
mother liquor: ``log10(s0 / s) = sum_i k_i m_i`` (``log: ln``: the natural logarithm), with
``m_i`` the molality of spectator ``i`` in the mother liquor (mol per kg of free solvent)
and ``k_i`` its coefficient on the molal scale (kg/mol; a molar-scale constant in L/mol is
converted with its source's liquor density beforehand).

coefficients.description: Spectator id -> k_i (kg/mol, positive salting out, negative salting in); every spectator of the crystallizer once, 0 stated where it has no effect.
coefficients.title: Coefficients

SaltingOut.title: SaltingOut

Selectivity.description:
A conversion reactor given as reported: the per-pass ``conversion`` of the ``key``
component and the molar selectivity to each product, ``F_p formed / F_key converted``. The
extents of the reactions follow (series and parallel side reactions in one step).

key.description: The component converted (a reactant of the reactions).
key.title: Key

conversion.description: Per pass, of the key's inlet flow.
conversion.title: Conversion

products.description: Product id -> kmol formed per kmol of the key converted.
products.title: Products

uncertainty.description: Of the conversion and the selectivities, e.g. {conversion: {gsd2: 1.1}, products: {B: {distribution: triangular, low: 0.9, high: 1.1}}}: sampled by cheme process reactor-uncertainty.

Selectivity.title: Selectivity

SelectivityUncertainty.description:
The uncertainty of a ``selectivity:``'s figures, each relative to its value: sampled by
cheme process reactor-uncertainty, never part of an outlet's fingerprint.

products.description: Product id -> the uncertainty of its selectivity.
products.title: Products

SelectivityUncertainty.title: SelectivityUncertainty

SolidSeparation.description:
A filter or centrifuge: the fraction of the solid that reaches the cake and the liquid
the cake holds, specified (no filtration or centrifuge model); the liquid divides with the
same composition between cake and filtrate. ``outlets`` maps ``cake`` and ``filtrate`` to
the step's outlet ports (inside a ``crystallizer:``, the crystallizer's own outlets).

solid_recovery.description: Fraction of the solid to the cake.
solid_recovery.title: Solid Recovery

filtration.description: The filtration time of a batch (Ruth), for a recipe's filter from:.

SolidSeparation.title: SolidSeparation

Solubility.description:
The solubility of a crystallizer's solute in its solvent: ``points`` (temperature in K,
value), interpolated linearly at the crystallizer's temperature and never extrapolated, or
one ``value`` that holds at the crystallizer's conditions as stated by its source (the
saturated mother liquor; no temperature dependence claimed).

With spectator solutes (``crystallizer.spectators``), the solubility is either measured in
that mother liquor (``measured_in: mother_liquor``) or the pure solvent's corrected by a
``salting_out:`` (Setschenow) coefficient per spectator; a pure-solvent value alone is
refused (``cheme.process-crystallizer``).

unit.description: kg of anhydrous solute per kg of solvent (g/100 g divided by 100), the solute's mass fraction in the saturated solution (spectators included), or kg per kg of solute-free liquor (solvent plus spectators; measured_in: mother_liquor).
unit.title: Unit

measured_in.description: Where the data were measured: in the pure solvent, or in the crystallizer's mother liquor with its spectator solutes (at the composition its source states).
measured_in.title: Measured In

salting_out.description: Setschenow coefficients that correct the pure-solvent data for the spectators' molality in the mother liquor.

Solubility.title: Solubility

energy_port.description: A batch or semi-batch reactor, batch still, crystallizer or conversion step: the energy port whose stream carries the model's year-average duty (cheme process propagate writes it, or compares a given one); default: its one heat stream (an energy stream from or to a heating or cooling utility). A stream from or to another block or step is heat only where energy_port names it.
energy_port.title: Energy Port

still.description: A batch (Rayleigh) still or solvent swap.

crystallizer.description: A crystallizer (with its filter and recycle).

solid_separation.description: A filter or centrifuge on its own.

dryer.description: A batch (filter-)dryer or vacuum dryer to a residual moisture.

reactions.title: Reactions

conversion.description: Reaction id -> conversion of its key component here, instead of the reaction's own conversion (cheme process propagate).
conversion.title: Conversion

reactor.description: How cheme process propagate solves the outlet: conversion (of each reaction's key component), equilibrium (of the reactions, ideal gas, at the outlet's temperature and pressure), gibbs (every reaction among the stream's components) or pfr (a fixed bed: the reactions' rate laws along its bed), cstr (stirred tanks: the rate laws at the outlet), batch (the rate laws over the batch time) or semibatch (a batch with feeds dosed into its charge: batch.dosing); none: conversion when every reaction has one.
reactor.title: Reactor

hazard.description: TD24 and MTT for the thermal screening of the reactor.

selectivity.description: A conversion reactor by the key's conversion and the selectivities to its products (instead of a conversion per reaction).

batch.description: reactor: batch or semibatch: the batch.

catalyst.description: The catalyst its bed holds: an id of process/catalysts.yaml.
catalyst.title: Catalyst

fugacity.description: Equilibrium and Gibbs reactors: the gas as ideal, or with Peng-Robinson fugacity coefficients (the components' critical constants) for high pressures.
fugacity.title: Fugacity

approach.description: Equilibrium and Gibbs reactors: K is taken at the outlet temperature plus this approach, K (positive: less conversion of an exothermic reaction).
approach.title: Approach

method.description: The class's method where DEXPI has one (e.g. Cooling).
method.title: Method

split.description: Splitters (SplittingMaterial): outlet port -> fraction of the inlet flow, for cheme process propagate.
split.title: Split

symbol.description: PFD drawing only: the ISO 10628-2 symbol to draw the step with (a symbol name as `cheme fragment shape` takes it, e.g. TANK_CONE_ROOF_SHAPE, MIXER_SHAPE), `junction` (a mixing or splitting tee) or `box`; default: its class's symbol.
symbol.title: Symbol

Still.description:
A batch (Rayleigh) still, shortcut level (the model: :mod:`.batch_still`): one charge
(the step's material inlet besides a ``feed``), boiled up at ``boilup`` and condensed
totally (one equilibrium stage, no reflux); ``outlets`` maps ``distillate`` and
``residue`` to the step's outlet ports, or ``cuts`` collect the distillate in turn (then
``outlets`` names the residue only). With a ``feed`` it is a solvent swap: the ends apply
once all of the feed is in (no end: it stops then; portions: down to the level).

pressure.description: kPa(a) of the still; default: the charge's
pressure.title: Pressure

nonvolatile.description: Components that stay in the still (solid components always do).
nonvolatile.title: Nonvolatile

column.description: A rectifying column on the still (batch rectification, ADR 0061).

condenser_port.description: The energy port (out, to cooling) whose stream carries the condenser's duty; default with a column: its one heat stream out.
condenser_port.title: Condenser Port

Still.title: Still

StillCut.description: One distillate cut: its outlet port, collected until its ``end``.

outlet.description: The step's outlet port the cut leaves by.
outlet.title: Outlet

StillCut.title: StillCut

StillEnd.description:
When a batch still (or one of its cuts) stops, one of: ``distilled`` (the share of all
charged and fed distilled so far, on ``basis`` mole or mass), ``residue`` (the key's mole
fraction in the still reaches the value), ``time`` (s of boil-up from the start),
``temperature`` (K of the still, at its bubble point: volatility raoult) or ``purity`` (the
cut's mean share of its key, on ``basis`` mole or mass, falls to the value: a product cut
collected to its specification).

time.description: s of boil-up from the start
time.title: Time

purity.description: The cut's mean share of the key falls to the fraction (basis mole or mass).

StillEnd.title: StillEnd

StillFeed.description:
A solvent swap: an inlet stream of the step fed into the still while it boils,
``constant_level`` (as fast as it boils up, the content's moles held at ``down_to`` of
the charge's) or ``portions`` (put and take: distil down to ``down_to`` of the charge's
moles, add one of the equal ``portions``, again, until all is in). The stream's flow is
the amount fed per hour of charge (the flowsheet's basis, as a semi-batch's dose).

down_to.description: The level: the still's content before each portion (constant_level: while fed), as a share of the charge's moles.
down_to.title: Down To

StillFeed.title: StillFeed

Tank.description:
A continuous stirred tank (``reactor: cstr``; the model: :mod:`.stirred_tank`): its
volume, or the space time V / Q0 on the inlet's volumetric flow, of each of ``count`` equal
tanks in series; isothermal (at the outlet's temperature, else the inlet's) or adiabatic.

volume.description: m3 of liquid or gas, per tank
volume.title: Volume

residence_time.description: s, V / Q0 per tank (instead of volume)
residence_time.title: Residence Time

catalyst_loading.description: kg of catalyst per m3 of reactor: for rate laws per kg of catalyst.
catalyst_loading.title: Catalyst Loading

time_on_stream.description: h: the age of the step's catalyst (catalyst:, its deactivation law) the tank is solved at. None: fresh.
time_on_stream.title: Time On Stream

Tank.title: Tank

Tear.description:
A stream at which ``cheme process propagate`` tears a recycle loop (ADR 0060): its flow
and composition are iterated until the loop closes, then written as calculated. A given or
assumed flow or composition of the stream stays fixed (a design specification).

stream.description: A material stream between two steps (or blocks).
stream.title: Stream

initial.description: The first guess; default: an empty stream (flow 0).

Tear.title: Tear

TearGuess.description: The first guess of a tear stream, where its loop's iterations start (ADR 0060).
TearGuess.title: TearGuess

Terminal.description: An external feed (DEXPI Source) or product (DEXPI Sink).

category.description: What crosses the boundary here; not given: unclassified (a gap the boundary-completeness check reports).
category.title: Category

utility.description: category utility: the utility and its temperature levels.

Terminal.title: Terminal

Tolerance.description: ``|in - out| <= abs + rel * max(in, out)``, in kg/h.
Tolerance.title: Tolerance

Uncertainty.description:
The uncertainty of a value, relative to it (see :mod:`.uncertainty`).

``lognormal`` with ``gsd2`` (95 % within value / gsd2 .. value x gsd2) or ``pedigree``
scores (five, 1 to 5: reliability, completeness, temporal, geographical, technological)
on a ``basic`` gsd2; ``normal`` with ``cv``; ``triangular`` or ``uniform`` with ``low`` and
``high`` multipliers (e.g. 0.8 and 1.2).
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

Units.description: The units a property without its own ``unit`` is in.

normal_conditions.description: Required when any flow is in Nm3/h.

enthalpy_reference.description: Required once any enthalpy is given.

Units.title: Units

UtilityLevel.description:
What a utility terminal supplies: its kind and, for heat, its temperature levels, which
``cheme process simulate`` checks against the temperatures of the duty it serves, and, for
steam, its pressure. ``cheme assess lca`` gives the energy exchange's carrier the level,
the supply temperature and the steam pressure (core#313).

level.description: The utility level's name in the design basis, e.g. LP, MP or HP steam, a hot-oil circuit or a refrigeration level.
level.title: Level

pressure.description: Steam: its supply pressure (flowsheet units; a gauge pressure is read against 101.325 kPa). It does not set the temperature: give supply_temperature (saturated steam: the saturation temperature at this pressure).

supply_temperature.description: Where the utility enters the exchanger (flowsheet units).

return_temperature.description: Where it leaves; not given: the same as the supply (condensing steam, a boiling refrigerant).

min_approach.description: Least temperature difference to the process side, K.

UtilityLevel.title: UtilityLevel

Vent.description:
The gas a batch or semi-batch gives off (ADR 0054): the listed ``components`` leave the
liquid as they form, by the outlet ``stream`` (the step's other outlet is the liquid). They
do not accumulate in the liquid and count in neither its volume nor its concentrations; a
``fraction`` below 1 leaves that share of what forms and keeps the rest dissolved.

stream.description: The outlet stream of the step the gas leaves by.
stream.title: Stream

components.description: The components that leave the liquid as they form.
components.title: Components

fraction.description: Component -> the share of what forms that leaves (default 1).
fraction.title: Fraction

Vent.title: Vent

ViewItem.description:
A persisted layout override of one object in one view.

Blocks, feeds and products: ``x``/``y`` (top left, sheet mm), optional ``width``/``height``.
PFD steps: ``x``/``y`` relative to their block's top left. Streams: ``waypoints``.
ViewItem.title: ViewItem

Volatility.description:
How a batch still's vapour follows from its liquid: ``raoult`` (each volatile
component's ``vapour_pressure`` in materials.yaml, the still at its bubble point at its
pressure) or ``constant`` (a relative volatility per volatile component, to any common
reference: ``alpha``).
Volatility.title: Volatility

schema.description: Feeds, products, blocks, steps and streams: the source of the BFD and PFD.

tears.description: Recycle loops torn for cheme process propagate (ADR 0060).
tears.title: Tears

convergence.description: How propagate converges the torn loops; default: Wegstein, 100 iterations, the flowsheet's tolerance.

bfd.description: How the BFD draws the streams.

schema.title: Flowsheet
